test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.**

The boy ______ to take the money.
solution:
The correct answer is '**refused**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**refused**'.
 
• It means 'to say or show that you do not want to do, give, or accept something'. [(किसी बात को मानने, काम को करने से) इनकार करना या बात नामंज़ूर होना]
 
 
• *Example: He **refused** to listen to what I was saying.*
 
 
 
• The word '**refused**' is used 'to say that you will not do or accept something'. In the given context it is used for a boy who does not accept the money he was given.
 
• We tend to go for **Option 2 **but it would be wrong because 'deny' means 'to declare (something) to be untrue'.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The boy **refused** to take the money.* 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **ordered**: to use your position of authority to tell somebody to do something or to say that something must happen. (आदेश, आज्ञा या हुक्‍म देना)
 
• **deny**: to state that something is not true; to refuse to admit something. (किसी बात से इनकार करना; किसी बात को नकारना). It can't be our answer as the boy didn't prove something false or didn't fail to admit something.
 
• **reminded**: to help somebody to remember something, especially something important that he/she has to do. [किसी को कुछ याद दिलाना (विशेषतः किसी ख़ास बात के लिए)] 
 
 

e8:T7fa,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
